faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications via email for the IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist posts is 08 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Research Scientist posts at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Project Research Scientist posts announced by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. These vacancies are distributed across different specific roles within the Project Research Scientist category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist recruitment is through Email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Research Scientist positions varies. For Project Research Scientist-I (Non Medical), it is Rs. 56,000/- p.m. plus HRA 30%. For Project Research Scientist – III (Non Medical), it is Rs. 78,000/- p.m. plus HRA 30%. For Project Research Scientist (M), it is Rs. 67,000/- p.m. plus HRA 36%.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications include a Post Graduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees), a Four Years Graduate Degree in Engineering/IT/CS, MBBS/BVSc/BDS or equivalent, or a PhD with post-qualification experience, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Research Scientist roles at IIT Delhi involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to download and read the PDF thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Project Research Scientist positions at IIT Delhi is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Delhi for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment and for further information related to IIT Delhi is http://ird.iitd.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for any updates or additional details regarding the recruitment process.
